rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Houses 7-9 m from the kerb along its whole length.
reasons: Next to a church and crossing

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 7 m, two houses 7 m, another 9 m; homes line the entire stretch with front gardens facing the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along this kerb, so a van could pull in.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road at a junction with pedestrian crossing.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; signs show P 5 Minute on Sundays 8am-1pm (church drop-off).

flags: Steep: about 2% mean, 5.8% max, flat in best section
sun_shade: Open to the west sun over the road; houses and trees shade the east side in the morning.

best_section.where: Ryans Road east kerb, between the two houses by the church
